title.narrative: HCFC phase-out management plan Stage II

description.narrative: The Hydrochlorofluorocarbons (HCFCs) Phase-out Management Plan (HPMP) Stage II in Albania was approved in 2020 to cover the period until 2026 and reduce the country consumption of HCFCs to 67.5% from the baseline. HCFCs are chemicals with ozone depleting potential and global warming potential used in variety of industries and applications. The HPMP Stage II is implemented together with the National Ozone Unit.
